1.0.1: Initial release with key management components: CreateKey, GetKey, UpdateKey, DeleteKey, VerifyKey, ListKeys, GetAPI, and UpdateKeyRemaining.
1.1.0: add MakeApiCall component with key-value array inputs for headers and parameters per standard #1459
1.1.1: Added output schemas with examples to CreateKey.
1.1.2: GetKey, GetAPI, UpdateKeyCredits and ListKeys now declare the Unkey v2 response they actually receive (GetKey: keyId, credits, identity, … instead of the v1 id / apiId / remaining; GetAPI: id and name), with examples. UpdateKeyCredits returned empty credits — it now outputs the remaining credits and the refill settings. ListKeys fetched only the first 100 keys (v2 moved hasMore / cursor under pagination) and sent the owner filter as the removed ownerId — both fixed.
